|descr= Sets flag [[Side]]. A flag may be taken by any unit that is enemy to the side that owns the flag. |x1= <sqf>_flag1 setFlagSide east;</sqf>

<sqf>

_flag setFlagTexture "\A3\Data_F\Flags\Flag_CSAT_CO.paa";
_flag setFlagSide east;
</sqf>
